en-US.title: Hisaab: GST Bill & Invoice
en-US.subtitle: Khata, Udhaar & Billing App
en-US.description:
Hisaab is a simple GST billing and accounts app for Indian shops and small businesses. Make a bill in seconds, share it on WhatsApp, and see who owes you money.

SAY OR TYPE YOUR BILL
Write "Sharma ji ko 5000 ka bill" or tap the mic and speak in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Hisaab fills in the party, items and amounts for you.

GST DONE RIGHT
CGST and SGST for the same state, IGST for other states, GSTIN checking, round-off and clean tax invoices.

SHARE AND GET PAID
Send bills on WhatsApp, share a PDF, and show a UPI QR code on every bill so customers can pay you straight away.

KNOW WHO OWES YOU
Track parties, payments and dues. Payments are matched to the oldest open bills automatically. Send reminders in one tap.

STOCK AND BARCODES
Keep items with rates, GST and stock. Scan a barcode to add an item.

BACKUP AND RESTORE
Your data stays on your phone. Back it up and restore it any time.

FREE TO START
Make up to 50 bills every month for free, across all your businesses. Hisaab Premium unlocks unlimited bills, invoice themes, multiple businesses and due-date reminders.

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription: Monthly or Yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.
